image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a vintage-style wire-spoke car wheel mounted on a yellow vehicle. The wheel features numerous thin metal spokes radiating from a central chrome hub cap to the outer rim. A black rubber tire with visible sidewall texture surrounds the rim. The background shows asphalt pavement and a portion of the yellow car body/fender.

Several wire spokes appear to merge into the central hub cap without clear attachment points, or fade into the reflection, lacking the precise mechanical connectivity expected in a wire wheel.
The edge of the yellow car body curves unnaturally and seems to float slightly above the wheel well area, lacking a clear mounting point or shadow grounding.

The visual conformance is high, but functional details are partially missing or obscured.
